arguments.command:
python3 << 'EOF'
import statistics

# Customs (tariff) net receipts for each month in 1974 (in millions)
customs_net = [304, 239, 277, 286, 295, 301, 325, 355, 305, 347, 319, 307]

print("Customs net receipts for 1974 (millions of dollars):")
print(customs_net)
print()

# Calculate mean
mean = statistics.mean(customs_net)
print(f"Mean: {mean}")

# Calculate population standard deviation (ddof=0)
std_dev = statistics.pstdev(customs_net)
print(f"Population Standard Deviation: {std_dev}")

# Calculate Coefficient of Variation (CV) as percentage
cv = (std_dev / mean) * 100
print(f"Coefficient of Variation: {cv}%")

# Round to nearest hundredths
cv_rounded = round(cv, 2)
print(f"CV rounded to nearest hundredths: {cv_rounded}%")
EOF
